Hi Emma —

Appreciate the clarity. I put together a concise playbook and a starter SOW — attaching both. High level summary inline so procurement can triage quickly:

1) Modular Add-ons (low commitment)
   - Audit logs: $0.08 / GB-month for 90d retention; $0.05 / GB-month for 1yr; $0.03 / GB-month for 7yr archived tier.
   - KMS: standard KMS included; HSM seats $6,500 / seat / month (dedicated HSM appliance abstraction).
   - Residency: single-region EU (no commit) + surcharge 10%; multi-region failover +20% and cross-region egress billing applies.

2) Dedicated Residency Bundle (12/24 mo commit) 
   - Includes reserved capacity for EU region, 2 HSM seats included in bundle, 30% discount on audit-log storage line items, and 99.95% residency SLA.
   - Example pricing for your mid-volume profile (est. 1.2 TB/mo logs, 3B tokens/mo): $X (see attached spreadsheet).

3) Enterprise Assurance Suite (for regulated workflows)
   - Annual commit, extended audit-retention (7y), full HSM fleet option, priority SRE-on-call, SOC2 + HIPAA add-on included.
   - Suggested crediting model: 12% base bundle discount + SLA credit pool (1% ARR credit if severe breaches of residency SLA).

Notes / negotiation playbook:
- Typical concession bands: 8–15% one-off discount on bundle for 12–24 month commits + 6–12 month implementation credit.
- HSM seat economics: if they want >5 seats, route to Dedicated pricing (amortized).
- We can offer a 3-month free audit-log ingestion window for pilots to reduce friction.

Attaching: Redwood_Pricing_Playbook_v2.pdf, Draft_SOW_Cardinal.docx, Price_Workback_Spreadsheet.xlsx

Do you want me to include a targeted concession in the playbook to give procurement something concrete (e.g., 12% on Bundle for 24mo commit + 2 HSM seats included)? If yes, I’ll also loop finance for approval.

Cheers,
Vivek
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
